title: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock: an open market dashboard with AI insights
friendlyTitle: OpenStock is an open-source market dashboard with AI features
summary: OpenStock is an AGPL-licensed market dashboard for real-time prices, company information, alerts and AI-supported sentiment insights. The actively updated TypeScript project has about 15,900 GitHub stars and supports configurable AI providers.
friendlySummary: OpenStock tracks prices, company information and alerts and includes AI-based market insights. The project has about 15,900 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Developers can study or self-host a full-stack market-monitoring application and adapt its alerting or AI-insight pipeline. Review its data-provider terms and AGPL obligations before using it in a commercial product, and do not treat generated sentiment as financial advice.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can run it yourself or learn how a market dashboard is built. Check the data licences and AGPL rules, and do not rely on AI sentiment for investment decisions.
